purpose: Verify AmigaOS 2.04 GUI create replaces an existing archive on an FS-UAE host-directory volume

gui.instrumentation_scope: Logging-only GUI trace build; archive behavior matches src/frontend/amiga_gui/main.c.

interaction: Boot Workbench and answer the PickMap prompt with 0 and Return.
Select Archive -> Open and open archive.bolt so the GUI holds the target archive open.
Select Compression -> Create New... using the GUI menu.
Enter SOURCE.TXT in the source requester and confirm.
Accept the default archive filename archive.bolt, which already exists.

replacement.result: GUI logged Create complete for archive.bolt.

cross_reader_verification.linux_full_test: Both physical entries passed; 2 files OK.

linux_full_extract.status: Partial because Amiga native metadata is unsupported on Linux

linux_mini_extract.status: Partial because Amiga metadata is unsupported by the mini extractor

additional_observation.scenario: Pre-fix create over an archive that the GUI had just opened
additional_observation.result: The new archive was published and Linux verified it, but the old open archive remained at recovery name BRA71936. The 8b47897 fix closes the matching open archive before publication; the primary run above verifies this case no longer leaves a backup.
additional_observation.scope_note: This confirms backup retention on the FS-UAE host-directory backend when replacing the currently open archive. The old archive remains available, but successful cleanup of an open target is not qualified.

scope_limit: An existing archive that was open in the GUI was replaced and cross-verified on one FS-UAE host-directory volume, with no stage or backup left behind. Failure after closing the old archive, native OFS/FFS replacement, GUI cancellation, and metadata preservation for a replaced archive remain unqualified.
